A '''churro''' was a type of food.

At the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] terminal of [[Spaceport THX1138]], droid security agent [[G2-4T]] mistook a passenger's churro for a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and asked that it be put away.
